_comment: ordinals are baseTurn-agnostic labels within the array (the first user message never increments; leading non-user messages share its ordinal); baseTurn only informs completed, where a leading non-user message past turn 0 is the tail of an earlier turn. Whole-turn coordinate cases shared by the JS hook SDK (agent-sdk/src/turns.js) and the Go importer (cli/internal/importer/conversation batch.go / uploader.go). Both must label, split and count identically or hook and import writes of one session disagree on ordinals. roles are message roles in order; max is the per-batch message cap; batches are index groups; completed[i] is the turns batch i completes.

cases.name: tail of a previous upload past turn 0
one turn longer than a batch
